transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Tanya. How's the right ankle since the boot came off last week?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It feels stiff and a bit swollen when I wear shoes all day. Pain is 3 out of 10 at night, and 1 in the morning.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Ankle plantarflexion is 40 degrees on the right, and 50 on the left.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Dorsiflexion is 5 degrees short of the left.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I've been doing the towel stretch twice daily and the ankle pumps. Mostly.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good. Single-leg heel raise strength test: you did 6 on the right, and 14 on the left.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I can walk the grocery store now without the cane.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Great. Let's build calf strength. I'm adding heel raises with a slow count.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My goal is to walk my daughter's wedding in June without limping.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: That's a clear goal. Plan: heel raises three times a week, and I'm dropping the towel stretch. Follow up in two weeks.

expectedFacts.statement: Stiff and swollen when wearing shoes all day
Pain 3 out of 10 at night, 1 in the morning
Dorsiflexion 5 degrees short of the left
Single-leg heel raise: 6 on the right, 14 on the left
Walks the grocery store without the cane
Goal: walk daughter's wedding in June without limping
Heel raises three times a week, towel stretch dropped
